title: THE WEIRDEST BORDERS IN THE WORLD
hook: These are the strangest borders on the planet.

items.say: In Baarle, the border between Belgium and the Netherlands runs right through houses.
items.label: Baarle

items.say: Point Roberts is part of the USA, but you can only drive there through Canada.
items.label: Point Roberts

items.say: Kaliningrad is a piece of Russia, stuck between Poland and Lithuania.
items.label: Kaliningrad

items.say: Bir Tawil is land that no country wants. Not Egypt, not Sudan.
items.label: Bir Tawil

items.say: Pheasant Island switches between Spain and France every six months.
items.label: Pheasant Island

items.say: The Diomede Islands: Russia and the USA, less than three miles apart, but almost a full day apart in time.
items.label: Diomede Islands

items.say: Llívia is a Spanish town completely surrounded by France.
items.label: Llívia

items.say: And Vatican City is an entire country inside a city.
items.label: Vatican City
